items.title: [ECG] NYU Information Session in Singapore (Tues, 13 Oct 2026)
items.author: Justin Arif Prawiradiraja
items.description:
Dear Students,
Please be informed that
New York University (NYU)
will be hosting an
Information Session evening
for prospective students. These information sessions are designed to help prospective students and their families learn about academic programs, student life, and the benefits of living and learning at a truly global university.
If you are interested in attending, please register your attendance at your won accord. Below are the details:
Date:
Tuesday, October 13, 2026
Time:
5 - 7 PM
Location:
International Community School Singapore (27A Jubilee Rd, SG 128575)
Click here to Register
!
Thank you.
Best regards,
Justin
ECG Department
